item.title: A year of ceasefire in Gaza through the lens of NPR's reporter
item.description: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.
item.content:encoded:
It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

item.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
item.description: Indian authorities have launched a major security crackdown in New Delhi, detaining thousands of protesters who intended to hold a mass demonstration against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.
item.content:encoded:
Indian authorities have launched a major security crackdown in New Delhi, detaining thousands of protesters who intended to hold a mass demonstration against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.

(Image credit: Manish Swarup)
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press

item.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.
item.content:encoded: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
item.description: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.

item.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
item.description: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.

item.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.

item.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
item.description: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.
